racecards.race_name: David Cole Memorial EBF Novice Stakes (Div I) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
David Cole Memorial EBF Novice Stakes (Div II) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Bath Luxury Toilet Hire Nursery Handicap Stakes

runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
runners.comment: Kaito arrives fresh from a last-time-out win just 10 days ago, and that sharpness makes him the one to beat, having run over today's trip before. Our rating of 72 tops the field of eight, though his earlier efforts were patchy and he carries 139 lb from draw 3.

Ground Force arrives in cracking nick, a winner last time out and a second two starts back, and he has run over today's trip before. Only three days since that success, though, so a quick turnaround is the main risk, and he carries 137 lb from stall five.

Won two starts back and was second the run before, so Q T Boy's form has real substance, and he has run over today's trip. Our rating of 70 ranks him third of eight, but a sixth last time out and 38 days off are the concerns.

Singing Blues is winless in her last three, finishing a fifth last time out after a sixth three starts back, though she's fresh enough after 16 days and has run over today's trip. Carrying 134 lb from stall 1, she sits fifth of eight on our rating, so she looks a midfield sort.

Time Glory arrives on a solid line of form, fourth last time out and second two starts back, and has run over today's trip, while our rating of 68 ranks her fourth of eight. The risk is that she is yet to win in her last six starts and carries 131 lb from stall eight.

Pirates Paradise is hard to fancy, having finished seventh last time out, seventh two starts back and fifth three starts back, and he is winless in that spell after 49 days off. He has run over today's trip and runs off 58, but our figures rank him seventh of eight.

Beaten in each of her last three starts, finishing eighth last time out, eighth two starts back and ninth three starts back, Divine Concerto has been winless in recent runs, though she has run over today's trip and returns after 43 days off. Our rating of 57 sits above her official 46, which gives her something to work with from stall 2.

runners.owner: E S O Racing Rowan Partner
runners.comment: Winless in recent starts and unplaced last time, Allaboutthelunch is hard to fancy, with finishes of ninth, ninth, fifth and eighth before a second two starts back, and he is rated bottom of eight on our figures. That one second and the fact he has run over today's trip are about all he has going for him from stall seven off 115 lb.

racecards.verdict: Kaito heads our ratings at 72 for this Class 6 contest over a mile on heavy ground at Bath, though only narrowly, and that slight edge is enough to make him our selection in a tight-looking event. Ground Force is just a pound behind on 71 and Q T Boy a further pound back on 70, so both have obvious claims, while Time Glory on 68 is close enough to threaten if the principals falter. Singing Blues and the rest look to have a lot to find, which leaves this a four-horse contest on our numbers, and Kaito's narrow superiority gives him the call, albeit with low confidence. Kaito is our selection.

racecards.race_name: Disability Inc Handicap Stakes

runners.comment: Kaleidoscope Eyes won two starts back and five starts back, but she was unplaced last time out after 27 days off, and she has run over today's trip and going. Our rating of 62 ranks her eighth of 14, so a 135 lb burden from stall 2 leaves plenty to prove.

Rogue Sea has run over today's trip and going and is fresh enough after 21 days off, while our rating of 68 ranks him second of 14 and makes him a leading threat from draw 14. The risk is form that has tailed off, with an eighth last time out and a seventh the start before.

runners.owner: Mrs Wendy Jarrett J S Moore
runners.comment: Fifth last time out, after a sixth and a fourth, Thiscouldbefun has slipped since winning four starts back, though she has run over today's trip and going and returns after 30 days. Our rating of 65 ranks her fourth of 14, but 133 lb from stall 3 asks plenty.

Spirit Lead Me arrives in top form, a winner last time out and again two starts back, and he's back quickly after just 10 days, having run over today's trip before. Carrying 133 lb from draw 6, he is our pick on overall profile, though our figures rank him fifth of 14.

prev_owners.owner: Exors Of The Late Mr John Hobbs

runners.comment: Look Back Smiling has been in the frame twice in his last six, a third two starts back and another five starts back, and has run over today's trip and going before, while our rating of 68 ranks him top of the 14. The risk is that he's yet to win in that spell and was only sixth last time out.

Riyadh Gem is a threat on our figures, ranked third of 14 with a speed rating of 68, and he has run over today's trip before, while his third four starts back is the best of a winless recent run. The main risk is a 167-day absence after an unplaced effort last time out.

prev_owners.owner: Stable Silks Inv D Mooney D Gibbons

runners.comment: Just Queen High is hard to fancy, unplaced last time and beaten in all six recent starts, with a seventh two starts back her best finish. Experience of today's trip and going, and a rating of 60 from 130 lb, are small positives, but a yard going 1/23 is a worry.

runners.owner: P J Mrs J P Haycock
runners.comment: Man From Havana is winless in his last five, finishing a ninth last time out and unplaced in the two runs before, so he is hard to fancy at 129 lb. He has run over today's trip and is back quickly after seven days, but our rating of 56 ranks him 13th of 14.

Divine Wish is yet to win in her last five, with two unplaced runs most recently after a fourth three starts back, though she has run over today's trip and is fresh enough after 22 days. Our rating of 63 sits above her official 58, but she carries 128 lb from stall 13.

Sixth last time out, and a second two starts back, show Rwenearlytheredad is competitive enough, and he has run over today's trip and going before after a 17-day break. Yet he is winless in his last five and carries 127 lb from draw 11, so the ceiling looks limited.

Havana Mojito has been placed second three times in his last six starts and was fourth last time out, only ten days ago, but he is still yet to win in that spell. Ranked last of 14 on our figures, he is hard to fancy, though he has run over today's trip before.

Equion was fifth last time out after a win two starts back, with experience of today's trip and going, but he has a patchy record behind that and a yard going 1/35 lately. Our rating of 63 sits seventh of 14, so he looks a midfield sort from stall four.

Pitney was fourth last time out just ten days ago, and he has a second four starts back, but he's yet to win in his last six and was unplaced two runs before that. He has run over today's trip and carries 124 lb from stall 1, while our rating of 62 ranks him ninth of 14.

Lovely Jubly was fifth last time out, with a third two starts back and a win three starts back, but she's ranked 11th of 14 on our figures. She has run over today's trip and going, and a 29-day break is no concern, though a ceiling around this level makes her hard to fancy.

racecards.verdict: Spirit Lead Me is our selection for this heavy-ground Bath contest, and the case rests on a progressive profile and a fitness edge that count for plenty in a bunched Class 6 over eight furlongs. He is rated 64, only four pounds behind the joint top-rated pair, so the gap is small enough for those factors to bridge. Look Back Smiling and Rogue Sea, both on 68, head the ratings and must be respected, while Riyadh Gem is another capable of playing a part. With 14 runners and little to choose between many of them, this is a competitive heat, but Spirit Lead Me gets the nod.

racecards.race_name: Thank You To Our Loyal Annual Members Handicap Stakes (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Wisper looks a leading threat, having finished third two starts back and a third four starts back after winning five starts back, and she's fresh enough off an 18-day break, with our rating of 90 ranking her second of 14. The main risk is a sixth last time out, plus 140 lb to carry.

Box To Box is yet to win in his last five, but two seconds four and five starts back show he can go close, and he has run over today's trip before. Our 93 rating tops the field, though the yard's cold run is a mild concern.

Royal Approval won two starts back before a sixth last time out, and his 84 rating, fourth of 14, backs him as a leading danger, having run over today's trip and carrying 138 lb from draw 11. The main risk is a 114-day absence, so fitness is the question.

Oratorical won four starts back and was third five runs ago, while his 87 rating ranks third of 14 and he has run on today's going before. The risk is a poor recent trend of unplaced, sixth and eighth, plus 60 days off.

Belfrina won last time out after an eighth two starts back, but that came 587 days ago, and such a long absence is a real concern; she has run over today's trip and going, yet carries 134 lb off 79 and is ranked eleventh of 14 on our figures.

Fresh from a win last time out, Due To Henry has run over today's trip and returns after 28 days, but he was a sixth and a seventh in the two runs before that, and 132 lb is a notable burden from draw 6. Our rating of 84 puts him fifth of 14.

Just An Hour won three starts back and was third two starts back, but he was unplaced last time out and is back after just one day, which raises a freshness question. He has run over today's trip, carries 130 lb from draw 9, and our rating of 82 ranks him seventh of 14.

Helga is hard to fancy after 246 days off, having finished fifth last time out, and she is ranked 14th of 14 on our figures at 64 against an official 77. On the plus side, she has run over today's trip and was a winner two starts back, from draw 3.

runners.owner: Lady Bamford Mrs Collins Bv Sangster
runners.comment: Three wins in her last six starts and a third two runs back point to a capable filly, though she was only fifth last time and returns after 62 days off, with a yard in poor form (1 from 24). She has run over today's trip and carries 127 lb from stall four.

Newtown Duke has been creeping backwards since a win five starts back, finishing third, third, fourth and then eighth last time out, though he has run over today's trip and returns after 17 days. A yard at 1/23 lately and a mid-pack ranking of eighth of 14 on our rating temper the appeal from 126 lb.

Kokoluna won two starts back and five starts back, with a second three starts back, but she was only seventh last time out 22 days ago. She has run over today's trip, and our rating of 76 leaves her tenth of 14, so she looks mid-pack here.

Sergei Breeze was a fifth last time out after a second two starts back, and he's yet to win in his last five, though he has run over today's trip and returns after 28 days. Our rating of 83 sits well above his official 73, but ranking sixth of 14 suggests a modest ceiling.

Albus Anne won last time out and was third two starts back, with a 21-day gap suggesting she's fit, but a pair of sixths before that and a 12th-of-14 ranking on our figures make her hard to fancy. She has run over today's trip and going, and carries 123 lb from draw 14.

Beaten into ninth last time out, The Dark Baron is hard to fancy, with fourths three, four and five starts back and only one win in his last six, though that victory came two starts back and he has run over today's trip. Our rating of 67 ranks him 13th of 14, and he carries 121 lb from stall one.

racecards.verdict: Box To Box heads our ratings on 93, three pounds ahead of Wisper, and that is enough to make him our selection in a wide-open 14-runner Class 4 over ten furlongs on heavy ground. The edge is a narrow one rather than a decisive one, so he needs to handle the testing conditions to make it count. Wisper is the chief danger on 90, with Oratorical (87) a further three pounds back and Royal Approval (84) also in the mix. Box To Box looks the most likely to prevail, though confidence is low in such a competitive field.

racecards.race_name: Oakenson Ltd Handicap Stakes

runners.comment: Burdett Estate has slipped since a win five starts back, with a ninth and a seventh before an unplaced run last time, and our figures rank him 11th of 13. On the plus side, he has run over today's trip, and a 38-day break gives him a fresh look from stall 13.

Born Slippy tops our ratings at 82 and has run over today's trip, but he's been winless in his last five, with a third four starts back the best of it. The main risk is a seventh last time out and a 51-day break.

Won last time out and only ten days ago, so she arrives fit, with a second and a second also in her last six runs, and she has run over today's trip and going. Carrying 136 lb from stall three, she's ranked seventh of 13 by our rating of 73, which suggests a solid but unspectacular chance.

Maharajas Express has won twice in his last six, including two starts back, and has run over today's trip and going, but he was eighth last time out, 30 days ago, and the yard is cold at 1/23 in the last fortnight. Our rating of 75 ranks him fifth of 13 under 135 lb from stall seven.

Nogo's Dream was second last time out and has been in the frame in two of his last six, having also finished a second four starts back, while he has run over today's trip and going before. Fresh after 31 days, he is yet to win but our figures rate him second of 13.

Mumayaz arrives a last-time-out winner and has run over today's trip, while our rating of 76 ranks him fourth of 13, so he looks a leading threat from stall six. The one concern is a stable cold at 1 from 35 over the last 14 days, with 132 lb to carry.

runners.owner: Mildmay Racing Pl Only Fillies Rc
runners.comment: Perfect Location showed she can win with a victory four starts back, and she's had a fairly fresh 22 days since her last run, having run over today's trip before. Our rating of 77 sits well above her official 70, though a sixth and a fifth since that win, then an unplaced last time, is the worry.

Musical Soldier arrives in cracking recent form, second last time out and second two starts back after three straight wins before that, and he has run over today's trip. Against that, 50 days off and a yard cold at 1/24 temper the case, while carrying 131 lb from draw 11.

Kiss And Run has finished sixth, seventh and sixth in her last three, though she did win four starts back and has run over today's trip and going. Fresh enough after 21 days, but she carries 130 lb from stall 10, and our rating of 73 ranks her sixth of 13.

Gelato has finished fifth in both her last two outings, and a break of 55 days raises fitness questions, so she is hard to fancy; on the plus side, she won three starts back and has run over today's trip and going before. Our rating ranks her tenth of 13.

Punchbowl Flyer has finished fifth, fourth, seventh and sixth in his last four runs since winning twice earlier in the sequence, so the trend is going the wrong way. He has run over today's trip and going, but our figures rank him 12th of 13 from stall 12.

Thunderous Love is yet to win in her last six, though a fifth last time out, nine days ago, follows two seconds five and six starts back, and she has run over today's trip and going. Eighth of 13 on our rating, she carries 124 lb from stall four.

Pedros Dream filled the runner-up spot twice in a row, a second last time out and another two starts back, yet he is yet to win in his last five and our figures rank him 13th of 13. A yard struggling at 1/35 and a 21-day break do little to help his cause, though he has run over today's trip.

racecards.verdict: Nogo's Dream shares the top rating in this 13-runner Bath sprint with Born Slippy, and we prefer him on a progressive profile and a fitness edge that should count on the heavy ground over six furlongs. Born Slippy is the chief danger on an identical figure, while Perfect Location, five pounds below our pick, and Mumayaz, six behind, complete the principal threats. Nogo's Dream looks the sharper and more improvable of the two at the head of the list, so he is our selection.

racecards.race_name: Bristol Motor Club Handicap Stakes

runners.comment: Third last time out, and a winner two starts back, Whiteley Way has run over today's trip and on this going before, and her recent form reads soundly. A 38-day break is the only query, though our rating of 65 backs her as a selection from draw 9.

Up The Anti returned to form with a second last time out, and she has run over today's trip and going before, while our rating of 62 ranks her fourth of 17. The main risk is a yard in poor form at 1/35 lately, and she is yet to win in her last six starts.

Roman Spring has won three of his last six, including last time out and again three and four starts back, and he's fresh from a run 14 days ago, having also run over today's trip and going. Carrying 135 lb from draw 10, and ranked only seventh by our rating of 60, he may be short of the class needed to go close.

Ranked top of the 17 by our figures at 67, well clear of his official mark of 54, Forever My Prince has run over today's trip before and gets a 36-day break; the concern is a winless run in his last six, with an unplaced effort last time out.

Kyoto has been fading in recent form, a third five starts back followed by a fourth, two fifths and then an eighth last time, and he returns after 47 days off. He has run over today's trip and our rating of 62 sits above his official 53, but he is yet to win in his last five.

Big Bard is winless in his last six, though consistent enough with a fifth last time out and another fifth two starts back, and he has run over today's trip and going. Our rating of 61 sits above his official 53, but carrying 133 lb from stall five leaves him a bit to prove.

Fourth last time out, after back-to-back wins two and three starts back, shows Rinky Tinky Tinky is in good heart, and 21 days off suits; she has run over today's trip. Carrying 132 lb from draw 2 and ranked ninth of 17 by our rating, she looks more midfield than match-winner.

Unico steps up on a third last time out, just 14 days ago, and her figure of 64 ranks her third of 17, so she looks a leading threat; she has run over today's trip and runs off an official 52 from draw 11. The main risk is that she is winless in her last five, with three eighths and a ninth before that latest effort.

prev_owners.owner: Ms H N Pinniger And Partner

runners.comment: Dusk Damsel is winless in her last six, with an eighth last time out and a sixth before that, so she is hard to fancy, though she has run over today's trip and a second three starts back shows she can bring her best. She is back quickly after 12 days, but 131 lb is a lot to carry.

Ken Brulee is hard to fancy after an eighth last time out and an unplaced effort the start before, though he has won once in his last six, a win four starts back. He has run over today's trip, but 131 lb from stall 15 and a 14th-of-17 ranking on our figures leave plenty to prove.

runners.owner: G E Bassett P R Chamings
runners.comment: Bonnita has finished eighth, ninth and eighth in her last three runs and is winless in her last five, though she is fit after 14 days off and has run over today's trip and going. Our rating of 57 sits above her official 50, but carrying 130 lb from stall 12 leaves her a lot to find.

prev_owners.owner: J A Grimes C Lacey G Lacey Partner

runners.comment: Winless in her last five, Grimese's Special has finished sixth, fifth, fifth and eighth in her last four, so she is hard to fancy, and our figures have her 16th of 17. She has run over today's trip and going and carries 129 lb from draw 7 after 38 days off.

Hard to fancy at the bottom of our figures, with a seventh and an eighth in the middle of his last six runs, though he was third last time out, and a winner six starts back. He has run over today's trip and returns after 23 days, but our rating has him ranked 17 of 17.

Mintana was fifth last time out, 16 days ago, and has a second three starts back and a third five starts back in her recent form, though she is winless in her last six and was ninth two runs ago. She has run over today's trip, and our rating of 55 sits 9 lb above her official 46, but ranking 11th of 17 caps the appeal.

No Claims Bonus unseated last time out and is winless in her last six, with a fifth two starts back her best recent effort bar a second three runs ago, so she is hard to fancy. She has run over today's trip and is back after just 14 days, but our rating of 53 ranks her 15th of 17.

Just King High comes here fresh from a second last time out, just nine days ago, and has run over today's trip and going, but he is yet to win in his last six starts and the earlier form reads fourth, eighth, seventh. Carrying 126 lb from draw 17, he looks a mid-pack type on our rating of 55.

Winless in her last six, Blue Point Express was unplaced last time out just ten days ago, though she did finish third three starts back and has run over today's trip. Drawn 1 and carrying 126 lb, she sits 12th of 17 on our rating, so a midfield showing looks likely.

racecards.verdict: Whiteley Way is our selection in this wide-open 17-runner Class 6 sprint, and his progressive profile earns him the nod over Forever My Prince, who is only two pounds better on our figures. That slim gap is hardly decisive, so the preference for the horse on an upward curve makes sense, especially with the heavy ground likely to test stamina and sort out those who have plateaued. Forever My Prince is the chief danger as the top-rated runner, while Unico and Up The Anti are also capable of playing a part in a race with little between the leading contenders. This is a competitive heat and confidence is low, but Whiteley Way looks the right one to side with.

racecards.race_name: Mj Church Handicap Stakes

runners.comment: Alkuwarrior arrives fresh from a third last time out, and a third two starts back, after 10 days off, and he has run over today's trip before. Yet to win in his last six starts, he carries 135 lb from stall 13, and our rating of 68 ranks him fifth of 15.

Red Snapper won three and four starts back, then a second two starts back, so this gelding is a leading danger, and he has run over today's trip and going before. The risk is a sixth last time out, while he carries 135 lb from stall six.

Fourth last time out and fresh enough after 21 days, Maid In Devon has run over today's trip and sits two pounds better on our rating than her official 62, but she's won once in her last six starts, with that success six runs back, and carries 132 lb from stall ten.

prev_owners.owner: Peter R Ball Gentech Ltd Partners

runners.comment: Act of Violence arrives with a solid recent profile, having been second three starts back and third four back, and he has run over today's trip and going before; our rating of 70 ranks him fourth of 15. The main risk is a stable struggling at 1/35 in the last 14 days, plus a sixth last time out.

runners.owner: The 19Th Hole Syndicate J S Moore
runners.comment: Call Time arrives in cracking nick, runner-up in his last two starts after back-to-back wins, and he has run over today's trip and going, yet 131 lb from stall 12 is a big ask. Our rating of 63 ranks him only twelfth of 15, so he is hard to fancy.

Arnaz is a leading danger, a dual winner five and six starts back who has run over today's trip and on this going, and he's fresh enough after 17 days off; our rating of 70 sits third of 15 and comfortably above his official 61. The risk is a recent slump of three sixths in his last four outings.

runners.owner: Pcf Racing Ltd Ceramic Tile Merchants
runners.comment: Jenny Jerome is winless in her last six, with an unplaced effort last time out and a second six starts back her best recent finish, so she is hard to fancy. She has run over today's trip and is back quickly after eight days, but 130 lb from draw 7 is a big ask, and our figures rank her 11th of 15.

Neptune Legend was beaten in ninth last time out, though a fifth two starts back and a win six starts back show some ability, and he has run over today's trip. A 16-day break and a cold yard (1/35) hold him back, while our rating of 64 sits above his official 60.

Emporess has been well beaten lately, an eighth last time out and winless in her last five, though a quick 10-day turnaround and previous experience over today's trip and going give her a platform. A yard out of form (1/35) and 130 lb from stall four temper enthusiasm, though our rating of 65 sits above her official 60.

Two And Two is yet to win in her last six, but she was a fourth last time out just ten days ago and has run over today's trip and going, while our rating of 74 ranks her top of the 15 and well clear of her official mark of 60.

Savannah Smiles is winless in her last six, with a fourth three starts back her best finish and an unplaced effort last time, so she is hard to fancy. She has run over today's trip and going, and is back quickly after ten days, but our rating of 61 ranks her 14th of 15.

Legendsoftheland was fourth last time out after an eighth two starts back, so the recent trend is hard to love, and our rating has him 13th of 15. On the plus side, he has run over today's trip and going, is back after just 15 days, and has a win five starts back.

Hard to fancy as the lowest-ranked of 15 on our figures, yet Iconic Dawn has finished third last time out, and a third two starts back, after a win three starts back, and she has run over today's trip. Carrying 127 lb from draw 11, she looks outclassed here.

Connie's Rose has been consistent, finishing fourth last time out, a fourth two starts back and a third three starts back, and she has run over today's trip and going. Yet she is winless in her last six, and carrying 126 lb from stall 17 leaves her a little to prove despite our rating of 67.

Lahina Bay is yet to win in her last six, though seconds three and four starts back show she can get involved, and she has run over today's trip and going; unplaced last time and an eighth two starts back suggest her form has cooled, with our rating of 63 only tenth of 15.

racecards.verdict: Two And Two heads our ratings on 74, three pounds better than Red Snapper, and that edge looks enough to make this runner the one to beat in this 15-runner sprint at Bath. The heavy ground will make this a testing five furlongs. Red Snapper is the main danger, while Arnaz and Act of Violence, both on 70, are close enough to be a threat if the selection is below par. Two And Two gets the nod.

racecards.race_name: bettingsites.co.uk Maiden Hurdle Race (GBB Race)

runners.owner: M A Middleton J Perry K Phillips

racecards.race_name: Dandara Maiden Hurdle Race (GBB Race)
bettingsites.co.uk Handicap Hurdle Race

runners.comment: It's Easy booked a second last time out and is back quickly after just eight days, with experience over today's trip and going, while carrying 166 lb. Our top-rated runner of six at 105, she is the one to beat, though the yard's recent form is a minor concern.

Hellfire Princess won last time out and also scored four starts back, so she arrives in good heart, and she has run over today's trip and going before. The one concern is a 227-day layoff, while she also shoulders 166 lb.

Winless in her last five and ranked fifth of six on our figures, Country Mouse is hard to fancy, especially off a 166-day break and carrying 159 lb. On the plus side, she was third last time out and has run over today's trip and going before.

prev_owners.owner: A K Hosie J P Romans W Van Der Horst

runners.comment: Ugo Bingo arrives a last-time-out winner after just 18 days, with a third two starts back, and he has run over today's trip and going before, while the yard is in form at 30% over the last 14 days. The main risk is the 158 lb he carries off an official mark of 95.

Doonbeg Don has a win and a second in his last five starts, a second three starts back and a win five back, and he has run over today's trip and going before, while our rating of 98 ranks him third of six. The risk is obvious: he was pulled up last time and was seventh the start before, with just seven days since that run.

Shanagolden Girl is hard to fancy, winless in her last four with a seventh last time out and a fifth two starts back, and she returns after 249 days off. She has run over today's trip and our rating of 94 is close to her official 93, but carrying 156 lb is a stiff ask.

racecards.verdict: It's Easy gets the nod in this six-runner Ffos Las staying contest, topping our figures on 105 and holding a four-pound edge over Hellfire Princess, which is a worthwhile advantage rather than a decisive one. The 20-furlong trip on good ground should suit a runner with that profile, and she looks the one to beat at this level. Hellfire Princess is the chief danger on 101, while Doonbeg Don and Ugo Bingo, both on 98, are close enough to pounce if our pick fails to run to her best. It's Easy is the selection.

racecards.race_name: Golwg Gwendraeth Handicap Hurdle Race

runners.comment: Lully du Houx has run over today's trip and going, comes here fresh enough after 20 days, and our rating of 102 ranks him third of seven, making him a live threat. The risk is a slide in form, with an unplaced run last time and a ninth two starts back, while he carries 168 lb.

Boyles Hill returns quickly after 12 days, having finished fourth last time out and a fourth two starts back, and he has been over today's trip and going before. Our rating of 103 ranks him second of seven, but the main risk is a yard out of form at 1/21 recently, plus 168 lb.

runners.owner: Berkshire Parts Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub
runners.comment: Berkshire Smudge is yet to win in his last four, finishing eighth last time out, with a fifth and a sixth before that, and he returns after 177 days off. He has run over today's trip and our rating of 94 ranks him fifth of seven, while 165 lb is a notable burden.

Whatsgoingonmarvin is winless in his last five, with a fifth last time out, two sixths before that and a second four starts back the only real highlight. He has run over today's trip and going and is fresh enough after 22 days, but carrying 164 lb off 97, our rating of 92 leaves him sixth of seven.

prev_owners.owner: D Smith Mrs J Magnier M Tabor M J Jooste

runners.comment: Department of War is our top-rated runner, and the 120 figure sits well clear of his official mark of 95, a gap that makes him the one to beat despite being without a win lately. He has run over today's trip and returns after just 16 days, though he was pulled up last time out and carries 163 lb.

Kates Choice was beaten into ninth last time out and rates the weakest of seven on our figures, with 160 lb to carry a hefty burden. In her favour, she won three starts back, was third two starts back, and has run over today's trip and going.

Dalcassian Girl bids to build on a second last time out and has run on today's going before, while our rating of 100 ranks her fourth of seven. The risk is a 221-day absence, plus 148 lb, with her still yet to win in her last four starts.

racecards.verdict: Department of War looks the one to beat at Ffos Las, with our rating of 120 putting him a full 17 lb clear of Boyles Hill on 103, a gap that should count for plenty over this two miles on good ground. Boyles Hill is the chief danger, while Lully du Houx on 102 and Dalcassian Girl on 100 are tightly bunched behind and capable of making it a contest if our man is below his best. The rest, led by Berkshire Smudge on 94, look to have too much to find in a modest Class 5 field, though confidence is only low given how open such races can be. Department of War is the selection.

racecards.race_name: Walters Group National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional & Amateur Jockeys' Race) (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Unexposed and open to improvement, Clondaw Sergeant was second last time out and has a third four starts back, though two pulled-up efforts sit in that run. He returns after 165 days off and carries 156 lb, so fitness is the question.

De Inovator showed up well with a second two starts back before a fifth last time out, and he's back quickly after just one day off, having already run over today's trip. Our top-rated runner, he is yet to win in his last two starts, but he looks the one to beat off 155 lb.

Unexposed gelding who won last time out and was third two starts back, so the profile is encouraging, though he returns after 214 days off and carries 155 lb. Lightly raced, he looks open to further improvement.
Memphis Bel is unraced, so this is a clean-sheet debut with nothing on form to judge him by; he's wholly unexposed and open to improvement, and he carries 155 lb.
Miravis is totally unexposed, with no recorded form to go on, so this gelding's debut is a leap into the unknown and there should be improvement to come. He carries 155 lb.

Lightly raced and unexposed, Mistral du Chenet was unplaced on his only recent start and returns after 222 days off, so he has to prove fitness; carrying 155 lb, he is yet to win and could well have more to offer.
Verney Fox was second on his only recent start, though he returns after 193 days off and looks unexposed, with scope to improve; he carries 155 lb and is yet to win in that limited form.

racecards.verdict: De Inovator is the only runner in this seven-strong Ffos Las field to carry a rating from us, and a figure of 99 gives him a solid platform over the 16 furlongs on good ground. The six rivals, including Clondaw Sergeant, Goodbye Earl, Memphis Bel, Miravis, Mistral du Chenet and Verney Fox, are all unrated, so there is little to judge them on, and any of them could improve past what we can see. Even so, with a Class 5 contest looking open, De Inovator's established level gives him the strongest claim on what we know, though we hold him with only low confidence. De Inovator is our selection.

Doctor Kildare boasts a winner four starts back and another three starts back, then a third and a fourth last time out, and he has run over today's trip and on this going before. The big risk is a 306-day absence, with 163 lb on his back too.

runners.comment: Mountain Mike was third and second in two of his last four, and he has run over today's trip and going before, while our figures rank him top of six. The main risk is a 189-day absence, with a fall two starts back and a fourth last time also in the book.

Muskoka has a fall and two pulled-up efforts to forget, but a second and a fourth before that show his ability, and he has run over today's trip and going before. Back in just 17 days, he looks our pick on overall profile despite carrying 162 lb.

Getaway Vic won two starts back and has been in the first three in three of his other recent runs, a solid profile for a gelding who has run over today's trip and going and is fresh from a 19-day break. The main risk is that he was pulled up last time out, and he carries 159 lb.

Beaten into seventh last time out after back-to-back wins, Loki's Mischief looks hard to fancy at the foot of our figures, and 156 lb is a big burden off a mark of 109. He has run on today's going and won twice in his last five starts, which is the case for him.

racecards.verdict: Muskoka is our selection at Ffos Las, and he looks the right call over this marathon trip on good ground. He sits just a pound behind Mountain Mike on our figures, so the gap is negligible, and the fitness edge he holds is enough to tip the balance in his favour. Mountain Mike is the main danger as the narrowly top-rated runner, with Doctor Kildare only two pounds behind our pick and Getaway Vic the other to consider, but none of them has the sharpness Muskoka brings. Muskoka is the pick.

racecards.race_name: Dai Walters Trophy Handicap Steeple Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Leader In The Park twice finished second before his latest outing, a second two starts back and another three starts back, and he has run over today's trip and going before; our rating of 134 ranks him second of six. The risk is a 250-day absence and a pulled-up run last time out.

Filanderer won three starts back and five starts back, but he was pulled up two starts ago, finished fifth last time, and returns after 208 days off. Carrying 167 lb, and having run over today's trip and going, he looks hard to fancy, with our figures ranking him fifth of six.

Third last time out and a second three starts back show Wreckless Eric is in the frame when it matters, and he has run over today's trip and going before. Our top-rated runner at 137, he is yet to win in recent form, with 188 days off the only concern.

Twice a winner in his last five starts, with a third two starts back, Just Over Land has run over today's trip and going before, and his 127 rating sits above his official 123. The one risk is a 194-day absence, and he was only sixth last time out.

Toothless returns from 189 days off carrying 162 lb, which makes him hard to fancy, though a third last time out, a second two starts back and another second three starts back show he was in good form before the break, and he has run over today's trip and going. Our figures still rank him sixth of six.

Patriotik's recent form is modest, but our rating of 128 ranks him third of six and sits well clear of his official 107, while he has run over today's trip and going before and carries 146 lb. The main risk is a 195-day absence, a pulled-up last run and a yard out of form at 1/21.

racecards.verdict: Wreckless Eric is our selection at Ffos Las, and he heads the field on our figures with a rating of 137, three pounds ahead of Leader In The Park on 134, which is a narrow but worthwhile edge over 20 furlongs on good ground. Leader In The Park is the main danger, while Patriotik on 128 and Just Over Land on 127 are the next best of a closely bunched pack who look to have a little to find. Wreckless Eric gets the nod, though confidence is low in a tight-looking contest.

racecards.race_name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap Stakes

runners.comment: Anthropologist won last time out and returns just five days later, a fitness plus, while he has run over today's trip and on this going before. A fourth two starts back is the one blemish, but his overall profile makes him our pick, and our rating of 78 backs that up.

Calyxoh has been placed in two of his last six, including a third two starts back, and he has run over today's trip and going before, while our rating of 75 ranks him fourth of 14. The main risk is a 55-day break and a 140 lb burden from stall 11, with him yet to win in that spell.

Dovey Moon is yet to win in his last six starts, but he's been consistent, with a third two starts back and another third five starts back, though he was sixth last time out. He has run over today's trip and going, and our rating of 75 sits above his official 70, yet 140 lb from draw 8 looks a stiff ask.

Quiet Resolve has run over today's trip and going and is back quickly after nine days, but he has finished ninth in his last two and is winless in his last six, with a second four starts back his best recent effort. Our rating of 71 puts him ninth of 14, and he carries 139 lb from stall four.

Galileo Island has run over today's trip and going and was third three starts back, but he is winless in his last five and unplaced last time out. Off 137 lb from stall five, he is rated 75 by us, five points above his mark of 70.

Up The Jazz was a fourth last time out just 16 days ago and has run over today's trip and going, but he is yet to win in his last six starts and has only a second four starts back to show. Our rating of 71 sits above his official 65, though he's ranked eighth of 14 from draw 3.

Fifth last time out, 15 days ago, after a win two starts back, gives Anton Mauve a bit to work with, and he has run over today's trip and going before. A yard without a winner in 21 and a modest ranking of 10th of 14 on our rating hold him back, carrying 134 lb from stall nine.

Mount King was second last time out, but that sits among a string of modest finishes, including a ninth two starts back, and he is yet to win in his last six. Rated 12th of 14 by us, he has run over today's trip and going, which is a small plus.

Exotic Baby is a leading threat after a third last time out, and he has run over today's trip and going before; our rating of 78 ranks him third of 14, with 28 days since that run. The main risk is a yard out of form at 1/23 in the last 14 days, and he is yet to win in recent starts.

Popeye Doyle is hard to fancy, having finished fifth last time out and been beaten in each of his last six starts, with a second five starts back the only real highlight. He has run over today's trip and going, but our figures rank him 13th of 14.

Winless in his last five, Have You A Minute has at least been in the frame lately, with a fourth last time out, a third two starts back and a second three starts back, and he has run over today's trip and going. Still, our figures rank him last of 14, so he is hard to fancy from stall 13.

racecards.verdict: Anthropologist gets the nod at Southwell, rated 78 and just a pound behind the top-rated Alcaraz, but we prefer him thanks to a progressive profile that suggests there is more to come in this 14-runner Class 5 over a mile. Alcaraz is the obvious danger on 79, and Exotic Baby, on the same figure as our pick, is just as hard to dismiss, while Calyxoh on 75 could also be involved at the business end. The margins between them are narrow, so improvement is likely to decide it, and Anthropologist looks the one still on the upgrade. Anthropologist is our selection.

Passerine arrives in sound recent form, third last time out and a second three starts back, and she is fit after just 14 days off, having run over today's trip before. Our rating of 81 makes her the one to beat, though she is yet to win in her last five.

Lilywhite Hart was sixth last time out after a third two starts back, which is her best recent effort, and she has run over today's trip. She's yet to win in her last six starts, though, and 135 lb from draw 10 asks plenty, even if our rating of 72 ranks her fifth of 14.

Wintour is winless in her last three, though a fourth last time out, after a sixth two starts back and a ninth three starts back, shows she is heading the right way. She has run over today's trip and is fresh enough after 20 days, but 135 lb from stall 8 is a lot to carry.

Kochella is winless in her last five, with a seventh last time out, though she was third two starts back, and a 71-day break raises fitness questions. She has run over today's trip and our rating of 67 is above her official 63, but 133 lb from stall seven is a tall order.

Lopefernza was fifth last time out, and he has finished sixth and seventh in the starts before, so he is consistent but yet to win in his last four starts. He has run over today's trip and going, and our rating of 62 sits a few pounds above his official 59, though 129 lb from stall 13 after 35 days off keeps him mid-pack.

Ten of Clubs is winless in his last six, with an eighth last time out and just a third three starts back to show, while a yard going 1 from 35 offers little encouragement. He has run over today's trip and going and is back quickly after 10 days, but ranked 11th of 14 on our figures he is hard to fancy.

racecards.verdict: Passerine heads our ratings at 81 and is the logical choice in a competitive 14-runner Class 6 contest at Southwell, with a two-pound edge over Perfect Hope that is narrow rather than decisive. Perfect Hope is the chief danger, while Hoosier (74) and From Me To You (73) also sit close enough to pick up the pieces if our selection fails to fire. The field is wide open and confidence is low, but Passerine's superior rating gives her the best credentials on the day, so she is our pick.

Edmond Halley is the chief danger given his narrow rating advantage, with Ramon di Loria level with our pick on 59 and Mister Sky Blue two pounds back on 57 also needing to be respected. In a competitive Class 6 field with little to separate the principals, the progressive Distillate is the one to side with.

Sanditon was a seventh last time out, though a second two starts back shows he can pick up a cheque, and he has run over today's trip and going before. Yet to win in his last six and with a yard 0/31 lately, he looks a midfield type from draw 7.

Blackjack is the chief danger on 59, with Little Beck Annie and Coulsty Exchange both a few pounds further back on 56 and capable of making the frame if our selection slips up. A big field on the Southwell sand can bring trouble in running, but Zabriskie Point has enough in hand on our ratings to be our selection.

Dapper Guest has been unplaced in his last two starts after back-to-back wins three and four starts back, and that dip is hard to ignore at 132 lb off an official rating of 87. He has run over today's trip and going and is fit enough after 16 days, but our rating of 76 ranks him last of 14.

This is a tight and open contest, but First Legion's upward trajectory makes him the one to side with.
